items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Oh, false something you used to call it. Falsetta or something.

ctx.x: And you want to make a lot of racket there. You swap back from open to two and three. Something like that, you know? Oh, yeah. Off cover. You know what I mean? You know what I mean? Now, just stay in there and moving back and forth like you were playing the seat. I used to do something like this show, man. See? Well, that's the same note but played with alternate fingering. Yeah. Alternate fingering. Yeah. Is the idea there. Yeah, the alternate fingering makes it a little bit out of pitch. Yeah. That's what makes…
Oh, false something you used to call it. Falsetta or something. Yeah.
